units.source_text: 薰中纳言和匂亲王逢时逢节都有信来。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, and Prince Niou sent letters whenever occasions or seasonal observances came around.

units.source_text: 但多半是无甚意味的冗谈，照例省略不记。

en.t: But most of them were idle chatter of little meaning, so as usual they are omitted from the record.

units.source_text: 樱花盛开之时，匂亲王回想起去春咏“效颦插鬓边”之诗赠女公子之事。

en.t: When the cherry blossoms were in full bloom, Prince Niou remembered how the previous spring he had composed the poem about imitating another and tucking blossoms by his temples, and sent it to the young ladies.

units.source_text: 当时陪伴他游宇治的公子哥儿们说道：“八亲王的山庄真有意思，可惜不能再访。”

en.t: The young noblemen who had accompanied him on that visit to Uji said, "Prince Hachi's mountain villa was truly delightful; what a pity that we cannot visit it again."
They all praised and admired it with one voice.

units.source_text: 匂亲王听了不胜恋慕，便赋诗赠两女公子。

en.t: Hearing this, Prince Niou was overcome with longing, and he composed a poem to send to the two young ladies.
